  • Enum Constant Details

    • REGISTERED

      public static final ChaosDiagnostics.ScenarioState REGISTERED
      The scenario was registered but has not been started yet. Matches no operations. Occurs when using ActivationPolicy.StartMode.MANUAL before ChaosActivationHandle.start() is called.

    • ACTIVE

      public static final ChaosDiagnostics.ScenarioState ACTIVE
      The scenario is running and will evaluate its selector against matching operations. Effects fire when selector matches and ActivationPolicy constraints pass.

    • INACTIVE

      public static final ChaosDiagnostics.ScenarioState INACTIVE
      The scenario has ended on its own. Occurs when ActivationPolicy.activeFor() has elapsed, ActivationPolicy.activeUntil() has passed, ActivationPolicy.maxApplications() is exhausted or its stressor stopped (a stop leads to STOPPED). Final for the handle: no effects fire again, and start() does nothing.

    • STOPPED

      public static final ChaosDiagnostics.ScenarioState STOPPED
      The scenario was explicitly stopped via ChaosActivationHandle.stop() or ChaosActivationHandle.close(). Terminal state — cannot be restarted.

    • FAILED

      public static final ChaosDiagnostics.ScenarioState FAILED
      Reserved; never reported. A scenario that fails to activate is not registered, so it has no report: its failure is recorded as an ChaosDiagnostics.ActivationFailure in the ChaosDiagnostics.Snapshot.
